frame.z: elevation above sea level (m, NAVD88 via DOGAMI bare earth)
frame.crs: EPSG:32610 (UTM 10N), shifted: x = E - 528238.83, y = N - 5036060.70, metres
frame.raster_rule: 1 m rasters: row 0 is north; pixel (r, c) covers x in [c, c+1), y in [810-r, 811-r)

credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · lidar: Oregon DOGAMI 2014 (OLC Metro)
method: local maxima (5x5) of the nDSM (gaussian 1 m) inside canopy.tif, >= 3 m, then the rest of the canopy (2 m stride, random order) as fill candidates, Poisson-disk thinned tallest first with spacing max(3 m, 0.55 x height); crown radius = clamp(min(0.3h + 1.5, distance to canopy edge + 1.5), 1.5, 9); form = conifer when the smoothed surface 3 m from the apex is < 92 % of the apex height (h >= 18 m) or < 84 % (12-18 m); a heuristic, not a species map. Conifer crown radius is capped at 0.18 h + 1 m. Fill instances copy the nearest peak within 15 m. No lidar east of x ~ 1136 m, so that strip has OSM trees only.
